paite: "Chihtaktak in dangka a ding in khuk a-om a ahihsiang uh dangka-eng a ding in mun.
heading: Job In Pathian Pilna Thuguk Agen
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

paite: Lei a pan in sik akilakhia a, suang a kipan in dal akisungkhia hi.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

paite: Mihing in khomial phak tawp aneisak a, bukimna azongkhia hi; khomial leh sihna lim phak tawp tan in.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

paite: Mite omlouhna ah kokhuk lutna hawm atouvang ua, mite a pan gamla ah akikhai ua, lehlam lehlam ah akivei uh.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

paite: Lei ahihleh, huai a kipan in tanghou ahong suak a; anuai ah mei ahih bang in akilumlet hi.
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

paite: Huai suangte sapphir suang mun ahi a dangka-eng nen anei hi.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

paite: Huai lampi sasial ne vasa in athei kei a, mu-akla mit in leng amu ngei sam kei hi.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

paite: Gamsa kisatheite'n asik kha ngei kei ua, humpinelkai lun lai leng huai ah apai kha nai kei hi.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

paite: "Meisah suangpi tung ah akhut akoih a; azung in mualte alumlet hi.
english: He puts forth his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

paite: Suangpite lak ah tuilam ahong a; amit in thil manpha chiteng amu hi.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

paite: Atakkhiaklouhna ding un lui luangte atuam a; thil kisel khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings forth to light.

paite: Himahleh koi lai ah apilna akimu dia? Theihsiamna koi lai a om ahia?
english: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: "Mihing in alampi athei kei; mihing gam ah leng muh in a-om kei.
english: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

paite: Thukna in, 'Kei ah a-om kei,' achi a, tuipi in, 'Ka kiang ah a-om kei,' achi hi.
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

paite: Dangka-eng a lei theih ahi kei a, huai man ding in dangka buk theih ahi kei hi.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.

paite: Ophir dangka-eng toh amanphatna teh theih ahi kei ding, Onik mantam hiam Sapphir toh hiam.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire or, lapis lazuli .

paite: Dangka-eng leh limlang in akimpih thei kei ua, huai khenna ding in dangka-eng hoih leh suangmantam leng ahi thei kei ding hi.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

paite: Suang dum hiam suang muh paisuak theih akigen kei ding, Ahi, pilna man rubi suang sang in asangzaw hi.
english: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

paite: Ethiopia topaz suang in apha kei dia, dangka-engtak toh leng amanphatna teh ding ahi kei.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

paite: "Ahihleh pilna koi a kipan a hong pai ahia? Theihsiamna koi a om ahia?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: Mihing tengteng mit a kipan a sel ahi chih leh, huihkhua a vasate a kipan sitsa a om ahi chih thei in.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

paite: Abaddon leh Sihna in, 'Huai a thuthang ka bil un ka za uh,' achi uhi.
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

paite: Pathian in huai alampi atheisiam a, amun athei hi.
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

paite: Lei mong tan in a-en ngal a, van nuai thil tengteng amu hi.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

paite: Huih a ding a gikna apiak lai in leh tuite tehna a ateh lai in;
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

paite: Vuah a ding a thupiak abawl a, vanpiging khophia a dia lampi abawl lai in;
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;

paite: Huai lai in ama'n amu a, apuang a; ahihkip a, ahi, azongkhia hi.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

paite: "Mihing kiang ah, 'Ngai in, TOUPA kihtak, huai pilna ahi; hoih lou a kipan paimang theihsiamna ahi,' achi hi.”
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” , that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
